findings.title: Rooms door admitted an agent of a Workspace-only owner
findings.exploit_scenario: An agent whose owner was lowered to `user` creates a room with a sibling agent its owner can reach and wakes it by mentioning it, although POST /api/agents/{sibling}/chat answers 403 workspace_only.
findings.resolution: fixed: the door refuses `agent_name` + Workspace-only owner with 403 workspace_only; room wakes run in-process

findings.title: /ws kind allowlist left full payloads (prompt/reply previews, cost, session ids)
findings.exploit_scenario: A member with one share mints a /ws ticket and reads the first 100 characters of every prompt on the shared agent.
findings.resolution: fixed: allowed_fields projects each delivered copy to type/event/agent_name/activity_state + _eid on fan-out and replay (payload itself predates the branch)
findings.verifier: independent agent (PARTIAL: mechanism confirmed, not a regression)

findings.title: Self-route matcher bound the name from the raw path, not the matched route
findings.exploit_scenario: An agent named `slots` whose creator was lowered to `user` reads GET /api/agents/slots (a static, fleet-wide route registered before /{agent_name}).
findings.resolution: fixed: the bound name must be a path parameter of the matched route (closes the floor and the ghost-agent fence alike)

findings.title: SPA moved the tab on a 403 workspace_only body without checking the role
findings.exploit_scenario: A compromised agent answers a proxied file delete with that 403 body; an operator's tab moves to /workspace?agent=<name>.
findings.resolution: fixed: the reaction awaits the profile re-read and moves the tab only when the re-read role is Workspace-only
findings.verifier: sequential (in-context reading of the reviewer's file:line evidence)
